claims.claim: AWS increased the maximum timeout for Lambda Managed Instances from 900 seconds to 5,400 seconds for asynchronous invocations.
claims.episode_span: Functions running on Lambda Managed Instances can now execute up to 90 minutes when invoked asynchronously or through an event source mapping.
claims.source_title: AWS Lambda Timeout Jumps 6x to 90 Minutes [2026]
claims.supporting_quote: AWS increased the maximum timeout from 900 seconds to 5,400 seconds, a 6x jump, but only for functions running on Lambda Managed Instances (LMI) that are invoked asynchronously or through an event source mapping (ESM).
